additional_info.subject: MeterValue Afcon-Driivz
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
We need your help with the MeterValue that is sent to the customer's OCPP.
I will describe the problem initially during the loading the values ​​that are sent to the customer are the Register and not the Interval so that the customer during the loading in his application interface sees very high values ​​of the charge (in money), in my opinion because it doubles the total loadings (Register).
At the end of the loading, values ​​of (Interval) are sent to the customer so that the charge at the end of the charge becomes the original charge that should be.
I will illustrate this during a transaction, I will take for example load position 170000126 transaction number 5256844 at 14:20:44 GMT
During the transaction:
At the end of the transaction:
It is possible to notice the values ​​that are sent during the loading and at the end, we would be happy to receive your support on how to handle this issue.
Attaches configuration from Driivz side.
Thanks in advance,
Orel.

additional_info.subject: 0379691 - ID0379691-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / ND 170000126] MeterValue at Inlet and Outlet CRM:00658000734
additional_info.body:
Dear Orel,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Saurav
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / ND 170000126
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
K5YipH
Problem Description
: MeterValue at Inlet and outlet
Troubleshooting
: Please find the explanation below
As this charger does not have LEM meter we can only receive total unit charged via Energy.Active.Import.Interval. It always starts with 0 and end at total unit consumed and then resets it value. But Energy.Active.Import.Register always starts with last captured metervalues and add total unit consumed during the charging session to it.
Now there are 2 places where we can capture these values, Inlet and Outlet.
At Inlet, we will receive combined values of all available outlet in that charger and at Outlet we will receive values for any one particular outlet.
If we take the example of same transaction id of the same charger, we can see in the start transaction message that meterStart value is "0".
2024-09-16T14:20:42.296158+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/11be168f4970[702]: OCPP: Send command: StartTransaction (fa9ee42e-4c9c-4561-be49-0b6daf401ab7) - {"connectorId":1,"idTag":"EEFF204E4029CD","
meterStart":0,
"timestamp":"2024-09-16T14:20:42.289Z"}
In the Metervalue we have both the parameters i.e. Energy.Active.Import.Interval and Energy.Active.Import.Register.
2024-09-16T14:21:42.840661+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/11be168f4970[702]: OCPP: Send command: MeterValues (c2c85a18-e845-4527-9a69-23db41818275) - {"connectorId":1,"transactionId":5256844,"meterValue":[{"timestamp":"2024-09-16T14:21:42.839Z","sampledValue":[{"value":"198","location":"Outlet","unit":"A","measurand":"Current.Import"},{"value":"160000","location":"Outlet","unit":"W","measurand":"Power.Offered"},{"value":"86922","location":"Outlet","unit":"W","measurand":"Power.Active.Import"},{"value":"1263","location":"Outlet","unit":"Wh","context":"Sample.Periodic","measurand":"
Energy.Active.Import.Interval
"},{"value":"380665938.28286594","location":"Inlet","unit":"Wh","measurand":"
Energy.Active.Import.Register
"},{"value":"14","location":"EV","unit":"Percent","measurand":"SoC"},{"value":"439","location":"Outlet","unit":"V","measurand":"Voltage"}]}]}
But the location of both the values are different.
2024-09-16T14:21:42.840661+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/11be168f4970[702]: OCPP: Send command: MeterValues (c2c85a18-e845-4527-9a69-23db41818275) - {"connectorId":1,"transactionId":5256844,"meterValue":[{"timestamp":"2024-09-16T14:21:42.839Z","sampledValue":[{"value":"198","location":"Outlet","unit":"A","measurand":"Current.Import"},{"value":"160000","location":"Outlet","unit":"W","measurand":"Power.Offered"},{"value":"86922","location":"Outlet","unit":"W","measurand":"Power.Active.Import"},{"value":"1263","
location":"Outlet
","unit":"Wh","context":"Sample.Periodic","measurand":"
Energy.Active.Import.Interval
"},{"value":"380665938.28286594","
location":"Inlet"
,"unit":"Wh","measurand":"
Energy.Active.Import.Register
"},{"value":"14","location":"EV","unit":"Percent","measurand":"SoC"},{"value":"439","location":"Outlet","unit":"V","measurand":"Voltage"}]}]}
In the StopTransaction message we receive Energy.Active.Import.Interval for location outlet.
2024-09-16T15:05:42.265103+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/11be168f4970[702]: OCPP: Send command: StopTransaction (54e20beb-7da8-4b9f-b7cb-668d5fdec6fc) - {"meterStop":48970,"timestamp":"2024-09-16T15:05:42.251Z","transactionData":[{"timestamp":"2024-09-16T15:05:42.251Z","sampledValue":[{"value":"84","location":"EV","unit":"Percent","measurand":"SoC"},{"value":"48970","
location":"Outlet
","unit":"Wh","context":"Transaction.End","measurand":"
Energy.Active.Import.Interval
"}]}],"reason":"Remote","transactionId":5256844}
So, it's please inform customer to capture only Energy.Active.Import.Interval for location outlet.
And meterStart will always be "0".
Hope this is clear, let us know if you have any other question related to this or can we close this ticket.
Awaiting your response.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0379691
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav Kumar

additional_info.subject: Update
additional_info.body:
Discussion with Afcon and Driivz on 22nd September.
Information provided to Afcon:
1) Informed about location "Inlet" and 'Outlet"
2) Difference between 'Energy.Active.Import.Interval" and "Energy.Active.Import.Register".
3) Difference between MeterValues Measurand and StopTransaction Sample Value.
Discussion with Driivz team:
1) How we can capture correct meter values during charging.
Solution:
Chargers with LEM meters will have Energy.Active.Import.Register and LEM address were updated. Cases without LEM meters will have only Energy.Active.Import.Interval. And Afcon will not show estimated cost for those chargers.

additional_info.subject: RE: 0379691 - ID0379691-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / ND 170000126] MeterValue at Inlet and Outlet CRM:00658000734
additional_info.body:
Hello Orel,
As discussed on our call on September 23rd, if the charger does not have an LEM meter, EcoG will calculate the total charging units and send the values in the
Energy.Active.Import.Interval
field. However, Driivz is currently only considering the
Energy.Active.Import.Register
field to display the total units (estimated cost) during charging on their backend application.
In summary, the charger is sending
Energy.Active.Import.Interval
to the backend, but they require
Energy.Active.Import.Register
. Since the charger lacks LEM meters, we are providing the values through a different measurand, which the backend is not considering. Ultimately, it is up to the backend to decide which value to use.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav
